name: RoseHosting managed Linux VPS

evidence.vps: 03: rented KVM Linux VPS with root access; RoseHosting operates the server, the customer owns the apps

line: Run Linux apps on a managed VPS with root access and NVMe storage.

free.text: No recurring free Linux VPS tier

cells.selfhost: Yes; root access to managed Linux VPS

work.math: $43.99 a month on monthly billing. Private-repo deployment setup is handled by you or arranged with support. 100 GB of transfer is within the unmetered offer, subject to reasonable use.
The fixed monthly plan has 2 dedicated cores and 2 GB of RAM for the 730-hour workload. Throughput has not been tested.
$64.99 a month includes weekly offsite backups. The required daily 7-day option has no published rate or retention, so the full total is unknown.
